desc: The Monitor blends tactical cutting ability with everyday carry convenience. Manual KVT ball bearings create smooth opening and the DuraLock secures the blade. Complete cutting tasks using the piercing spear point and slicey D2 tool steel edge with a flat grind. Grip the textured handle for greater control and pull back on the ambidextrous DuraLock to safely close the blade. It includes a reversible extra-deep-carry pocket clip for easy carry.
